title: [IMP-24] Connect required inspection results to their evidence
description:
Source task
PPAP implementation plan / IMP-24

Source plan
docs/phase 2/ppap/solution_specification/implementation-plan.json; plan date 2026-11-17; SHA-256 16059e862dd86c29ccbe374cabe8c001bbdab4667e74f46dadf2122b8f479d54

Task ID
IMP-24

Title
Connect required inspection results to their evidence

Category
Inspection connection

Objective
Let the SIA PPAP Engineer accept the exact result version needed for a required element.

Detailed scope
Add Inspection Result Link fields/controls and the PPAP-side link/acceptance operation. Preserve correct specification/result version meaning or a controlled artifact copy; only explicitly required inspection/run-at-rate evidence gates acceptance.

Deliverable
Version-specific inspection links and engineer acceptance controls.

Work needed first
IMP-01 — Create the PPAP Objects and workflow stages
IMP-05 — Set up element work and checklist answers
IMP-06 — Set up retained submission evidence

What the earlier tasks provide
• IMP-01 provides the new Objects, native stage/termination identities and target-record marker.
• IMP-05 provides the element/working-answer fields and typed preparation controls.
• IMP-06 provides the saved evidence/answer fields and protected history controls.

What is waiting
Partly waiting: local link/acceptance fields can proceed; external selectors, artifact connection and exact scope/version checks wait for supplied inspection bindings.

Recommended implementer role
Consultant

Recommended reviewer/approver role
Senior Consultant — PPAP build reviewer (a different person)

Why this role is recommended
The assignment connects defined records and actions through supplied native methods. A Consultant should configure the cross-record checks and failure messages; it does not assign the external application build.

Fields and features to set up
PPAP Inspection Result Link.Element
Create a link to PPAP Element, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Enable the reverse read-only list PPAP Element.Inspection Results. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly; creation action binds exact owning record; no later reassignment. Field/control lifecycle: Create Action Handler binds relationship in the authorized creation context; never user-reassign; preserve related-record history.

PPAP Inspection Result Link.Inspection Result
Create a link to Inspection Result, selecting exactly one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Assignee links authorized result during Work In Progress. Field/control lifecycle: Freeze exact result/specification-version reference on element submission; detailed measurements remain outside PPAP.

PPAP Inspection Result Link.Specification Version Reference
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Authoritative linked result specification identifier. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Link result adapter resolves exact frozen specification version; mutable latest-spec pointer is insufficient.

PPAP Inspection Result Link.Result Version Reference
Set the type to Text; up to 255 characters. Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: Authoritative fixed result/version identifier. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Link adapter must prove referenced result version fixed; if external tool only offers mutable result, copy controlled accepted result artifact into Evidence Snapshot.Files at Submit and preserve this source/version reference.

PPAP Inspection Result Link.Accepted?
Set the type to Yes/No (Boolean). Required. Initial value or continuing calculation: FALSE. Who can use it and when: Responsible SIA PPAP Engineer in Engineer Review, or explicit Retain Evidence action with current eligibility/compatibility validation. Field/control lifecycle: Explicit acceptance required for result relied upon by required inspection element; Retain creates receiving saved copy-specific link and stamps SIA PPAP Engineer acceptance through named action; native audit retains actor/time; unrelated failed programs do not gate approval.

PPAP Inspection Result Link.Acceptance Comment
Set the type to Text; up to 2000 characters. Required only in the conditions stated below; otherwise optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: SIA PPAP Engineer; required when rejecting result for use; optional when Accepted?=TRUE; retain on review. Field/control lifecycle: Native audit captures acceptance change; signed-off result links locked with approved saved copy, correction creates fresh working links rather than editing historical ones.

PPAP Inspection Result Link.Evidence Snapshot
Create a link to PPAP Evidence Snapshot, selecting zero or one target record (M:1; many source records may select it). Keep its inverse disabled. Optional. Initial value or continuing calculation: NULL. Who can use it and when: Users cannot edit this value directly. Field/control lifecycle: Submit binds result links to current saved copy; saved copy-specific links fixed after decision; new correction creates new links.

PPAP Element.Inspection Results
Create a read-only related-record list over PPAP Inspection Result Link.Element; one owning record can show many linked entries (inverse 1:M). Store no second link. Optional navigation only. Apply the owning-record and file permissions; make the list read only and populate it only through the declaring link, with no separate stored value.

Build instructions
1. Allow an authorized assignee in Work In Progress to create a result link whose Element is set by the creation action, not reassigned later. Validate its Inspection Result belongs to the intended PPAP/element part/drawing context and save Specification Version Reference and Result Version Reference.
2. Require a proven immutable result version; if the source result is mutable, copy its controlled artifact into the current evidence Files on Submit/Retain so later source edits cannot change approval meaning. Bind Evidence Snapshot when submission/retention freezes the link; correction creates new working links rather than editing historic ones.
3. Permit only the responsible SIA PPAP Engineer to set Accepted? during Engineer Review or explicit Retain Evidence. Record actual actor/time in native audit and require Acceptance Comment when rejecting its use. Validate required relied-on links before element approval; unrelated pilot programs/failures do not block PPAP. Keep detailed measurements, tolerances and specification publishing outside PPAP.

How to check the result
• A wrong-scope or mutable-latest-only result cannot satisfy a required element without its version/frozen artifact.
• Only required relied-on results need acceptance; unrelated failed pilot work does not become a blanket gate.

Information needed for this task
IN-07: Supply actual result/specification identifiers, valid released/version/scope settings and immutable result or artifact export method.
IN-04: Supply the supported link/artifact copy method for binding results to the correct submitted/retained evidence without altering old links.

Supplied input context
• IN-07 — Released inspection specifications and result evidence: The Product Management/Inspection owners must supply released-specification and result object/field identifiers, valid released states and scope keys, and an immutable result-version reference or controlled result-artifact export. Required review/result checks and links wait for those values; measurements and specification publishing remain external.
• IN-04 — Supported complete-save, copy and recovery methods: The technical team must supply the supported native methods for saving related records/files together, preventing conflicting simultaneous changes, retaining action/audit reasons, reopening an approved element without losing history, and durably resuming failed publication/submission/cancellation/outcome delivery. Only the consuming operations wait; no processing-permission or custom audit subsystem is requested.

Specification references
• [Target PPAP technical specification](ppap-target-technical-specification.md)
• [Canonical target field contract](ppap-target-field-contract.md)

Assumptions and open questions
New operational PPAPs only. SIA PPAP Engineer means an internal SIA user; supplier personnel act through their separate supplier roles.
